Animal spawning, calls and spawn eggs

Wild animals appear on their own as you walk, sail and fly around the world. Which ones you see depends on the biome and nearby water. This page covers where animals appear, how many there can be, which species call, and how to use creative spawn eggs.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

Where animals appear

The game checks squares of ground about 32 m across near you, as you move. About one square in five is left empty. In the others, one animal may appear, picked from the species that fit that biome. Where and how many animals appear

  • Up to 36 wild animals can be around you at the same time.
  • Each biome has its own small group of species. A meadow, a forest and a snowy tundra have different animals.
  • Wetlands, fens, flooded grasslands and deltas can have swans.
  • Each species has a cap. Wolves, bears, foxes and the big cats: 3 at a time. Boars, goats, buffalo, bison and giraffes: 5. Rabbits, frogs, ducks and river fish: 8.
  • Fish and other water animals appear only where the water is deep enough for them.
  • Animals do not appear on built roofs or on ledges around lanterns.

Flying and distance

New animals do not appear while you are more than 96 m above the ground. Spawning starts again once you come back down near the ground.

Any animal more than 180 m from you is removed from the world.

Swimming animals

Fish, sharks, whales and orcas keep swimming while you watch. They do not stop dead in open water. Each one follows its own swimming style.

  • Whales, orcas, hammerhead and frilled sharks, and flying fish keep travelling in open water. Between strokes they glide, slowing to about half speed.
  • Salmon, trout, carp, catfish, devil's hole pupfish and triops swim in short bouts and hold still between them.
  • Blobfish, comb jellies and giant squid mostly hover or drift slowly.
  • A swimmer turns away from shores, walls and the edge of loaded terrain before it reaches them. If it has no open route, it holds still.
Good to know. You cannot steer wild animals. Their swimming is set by the game and is source-checked, not play-tested in this guide.

Animal calls

25 species make calls: cows, pigs, chickens, sheep, goats, frogs, gulls, geese, swans, ducks, wild horses, wolves, crows, bears, boars, buffalo, bison, elephants, turkeys, blue jays, foxes, lions, tigers, snow leopards and panthers. Animal calls

  • You hear a call from an animal within about 24 m. The closer it is, the louder it sounds.
  • When several animals are close, the game picks one caller at a time and rotates through them.
  • Blue jays and crows call only while woodland birds are active.
Good to know. A call's loudness is set when it starts. It does not change as the animal or you move.

All 94 species

The game has 94 animal species, from cows and rabbits to whales, giant squid, bats and swans. Each one has its own spawn cap and biome groups. 94 animal species

Cow, pig, chicken, deer, sheep, rabbit, fox, boar, goat, frog, gull, goose, buffalo, duck, beaver, wild horse, bear, zebra, giraffe, elephant, hippo, salmon, trout, carp, turkey, peafowl, wolf, panther, tiger, lion, crab, turtle, crocodile, whale, ostrich, kangaroo, butterfly, roadrunner, gazelle, fly, hummingbird, orca, sunbird, gorilla, rattlesnake, hammerhead shark, lobster, Komodo dragon, capuchin monkey, cave centipede, moose, raccoon, blobfish, seal, cockroach, shoebill, snow leopard, crow, alligator snapping turtle, mantis shrimp, emu, platypus, Tasmanian devil, leafcutter ant, bald eagle, tarantula hawk, frilled shark, mimic octopus, toucan, maned wolf, anaconda, anteater, gelada monkey, jerboa, terrapin, comb jelly, giant squid, Devils Hole pupfish, catfish, flying fish, potoo, mudskipper, rhinoceros, sugar glider, skunk, banana slug, blue jay, caiman, triops, bison, bat, river otter, penguin, swan.

Creative spawn eggs

The creative catalog has a MOBS tab with a spawn egg for each of the 94 species. The ALL tab does not list eggs. Spawn eggs cannot be crafted. Animal spawn eggs (creative)

  1. Open the creative catalog and choose the MOBS tab.
  2. Take the egg of the species you want. It becomes the item you hold.
  3. Hold the right mouse button to wind up the throw. Release it to throw the egg.
  4. The animal hatches where the egg lands.
Careful. A quick tap is not enough. If you release too early, the game says 'Too hasty — wind up before releasing' and nothing is thrown.
  • A thrown egg can add animals above the normal 36 limit, but the world never holds more than 64 creatures in total.
  • In survival, a thrown egg uses one you are carrying. Eggs have no crafting recipe.

How this guide was checked

Spawn rules come from crates/voxelgame-core/src/entities/mod.rs at Voxelgame 51169272 (spawn rules) and 98c662d6 (species roster: Species::ALL has 94 entries; names from name()): the 36-animal cap, 32 m spawn cells, the empty-cell roll, the 96 m height limit, the 180 m removal distance, the per-species caps and the biome species groups. Call rules come from has_ambient_call, ambient_call and the 24 m falloff in the same file. Egg rules come from ranged_input.rs (wind-up, survival use, 64-creature limit for thrown eggs in entities/mod.rs) and ui.rs (MOBS tab only). A search of the game code found no spawn-egg crafting recipe.
